answer: Give each audited customer 10 noncopyable referral credits for allocating reward access to agents. Credits may pass along endorsements, but all recipients share the original budget: an agent mapping a canyon cannot turn 10 credits into 100 by passing them through a grove of clones. Internal transfers only move existing credit, so their ripple creates no extra payout capacity. An attacker seeking more access must buy credits from independent customers or earn them through real work; new account names alone yield nothing.
